# Sprout — agent reference

Sprout is a self-hosted control plane for copy-on-write database branches (Postgres, MongoDB, Qdrant). The CLI talks HTTP to sprout-server. Branches never talk to production.

Fetch this file live from the server you are using:

- GET $SPROUT_SERVER/llms.txt
- GET $SPROUT_SERVER/openapi.yaml

Repo copies: docs/llms.txt and docs/openapi.yaml.

## Clients

- Go: `./bin/sprout` (this repo). Config: ~/.sprout/config.json + SPROUT_SERVER / SPROUT_TOKEN
- npm: `sproutdb-cli` (binary name `sprout`). `sprout config set api-url <url>`
- Prefer whichever `sprout` is on PATH. Do not start a second server against a hosted VM.

## Scriptable output (use these in CI and agent loops)

Global flags (Go + npm):

- `--print-url` — stdout is only the connection string
- `--format json` — machine JSON, no extra dump
- `--quiet` / `-q` — hide progress

Examples:

```bash
sprout branch create pr-123 --from=prod --print-url
# postgresql://sprout:...@pr-123-alice-prod.host:5432/postgres

DATABASE_URL="$(sprout branch create pr-123 --from=prod --print-url)"
sprout env pr-123 --from=prod --write=.env.sprout
sprout url                    # current branch after `sprout branch switch`
```

Do not scrape human text. Default human output no longer appends a JSON blob.

## Typical loop

```bash
sprout login                  # GitHub device flow (hosted)
sprout doctor                 # first command on a new server
sprout connector preflight --mode=logical 'postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/postgres'
sprout connect --name=prod --mode=logical 'postgresql://...'
sprout branch create feat --from=prod
sprout branch switch feat --from=prod
sprout env --write=.env.sprout
# run tests against DATABASE_URL
sprout branch delete feat --from=prod
```

Dump-snapshot engines (Mongo, Qdrant) have no incremental `sprout sync`. Refresh with `sprout connect --wipe`.

## Current branch

`sprout branch switch <name> [--from=connector]` writes currentBranch/currentFrom to ~/.sprout/config.json.
`sprout branch list` marks the current branch with `*`.
`sprout env` / `sprout url` use the current branch when no name is given.

## Connect / preflight

`sprout connector preflight` (alias: `sprout preflight`) checks WAL, slots, grants, replica identity, local tools. It creates nothing.

`sprout connect --branch-sql=@anonymize.sql` stores Postgres SQL that runs on every new branch.
`sprout connector hook <name> --sql=@file.sql` updates the hook later. `--clear` removes it.

Engine inference: `mongodb://` → mongodb; `qdrant://` / `:6333` / `*.qdrant.io` → qdrant; else postgres.

## Idle compute

Server auto-suspends branches after SPROUT_IDLE_SUSPEND (default 15m). `sprout branch resume` wakes them. Set `off` to disable.

Postgres binaries are optional: a Mongo/Qdrant-only server starts without initdb/psql.

## Auth

Authorization: Bearer <token>
Optional X-Sprout-Org: <name-or-id>
GitHub users default to personal org `default`. Machine SPROUT_TOKEN sees everything. `sprout init` is machine-token only.

## URLs

Postgres: postgresql://sprout:<pass>@<name>-<github>-<connector>.<host>:5432/postgres
Mongo: mongodb://sprout:<pass>@...:27017/... (tls=true when SNI proxy)
Qdrant: https://<name>-<github>-<connector>.<host>:6333?api-key=<pass>

`/postgres` is the database inside the instance, not the branch name.
